wiki.title: Kevin J. McCabe
wiki.extract: Kevin J. McCabe (born 1958 or 1959) is an American Republican politician from Alaska representing District 30 in the Alaska House of Representatives. He was elected in 2022 receiving 3,662 (55.9% of the votes). Prior to redistricting he represented District 8 after being elected in 2020 receiving 7,533 (81.44% of the vote).
